quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 31, 2026) consolidated results: net sales and operating income rose. Material fell on the scheduled turnaround and inventory valuation effects in Essential Chemicals, while Health Care (pharmaceuticals profit growth) and Homes (firm domestic housing) rose. ROIC 5.9% (+0.4 pt), ROE 8.0% (+0.7 pt), D/E ratio 0.46.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 3,074,505 million (101.2% of the prior year); operating income JPY 231,200 million (FY2025: JPY 211,921 million); EBITDA JPY 4,275 hundred million; net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 1,588 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Material segment FY2026: sales and operating income fell. The Electronics business grew profit as sales of its main products rose on strong demand from semiconductor and electronic-device businesses centred on AI servers and high-end smartphones. Essential Chemicals fell on inventory valuation effects and a large scheduled turnaround at the Mizushima Works; Car Interior fell on lower volumes in China and North America; Energy & Infrastructure fell as the lead-acid battery separator divestiture, higher SG&A and price adjustments in the Hipore separator business outweighed higher chlor-alkali electrolysis plant sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Material segment net sales JPY 1,306,240 million (95.4% of the prior year); segment operating income JPY 68,321 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Health Care and Homes segments FY2026: Health Care rose on higher volumes of main pharmaceuticals and the first consolidation of Calliditas Therapeutics; Critical Care benefited from more LifeVest new patients and a new defibrillator launch but profit fell on higher SG&A. Homes rose on higher average unit prices in order-built housing and price pass-through in construction materials, while North American housing fell on lower demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Health Care net sales JPY 664,146 million (107.8%), segment operating income JPY 83,452 million; Homes net sales JPY 1,077,394 million (104.0%), segment operating income JPY 99,781 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-Term Management Plan 2027 targets (company): operating income of JPY 2,700 hundred million, operating income before goodwill amortization of JPY 3,060 hundred million, ROIC 6% and ROE 9% in fiscal 2027 (April 2027 - March 2028), the final year of the plan covering fiscal 2025-2027; around 2030, operating income of JPY 3,800 hundred million, ROIC of 8% or more and ROE of 12% or more. Management states pharmaceuticals, critical care and overseas housing are the main profit-growth drivers and that it expects high profit growth in Electronics on the rapid growth of semiconductor demand for AI.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 2,700 hundred million operating income target (fiscal 2027); JPY 3,800 hundred million (around 2030)

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics strategy (management): the company sees rising needs for leading-edge semiconductor technology as generative AI spreads and data centers expand. Its electronic materials and substrate materials businesses are rolling out high-performance materials that support the market expansion of leading-edge semiconductor packages and of substrates for AI servers and similar uses; it targets the market leaders in leading-edge and next-generation semiconductors as key customers and is considering strategic alliances and M&A around semiconductors. Management notes the business depends on the foundry / OSAT supply chain and monitors it, especially in the US, China and Taiwan.

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronic materials R&D: the company is developing high-value products for leading-edge semiconductor and assembly-process innovation (miniaturization, higher integration, higher speed), including the photosensitive polyimide PIMEL, the photosensitive dry film SUNFORT and glass cloth for printed wiring boards; for leading-edge package development it has built its own data-driven research infrastructure to automate experiments and evaluation, and uses IP data and materials informatics. Group R&D expenses for the year totalled JPY 110,537 million, of which Material JPY 47,545 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Group R&D expenses JPY 110,537 million; Material segment JPY 47,545 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex: FY2026 capital expenditure of JPY 222,324 million, centred on the Material segment (Hipore lithium-ion battery separator coating capacity and an integrated film-forming / coating line, hydroelectric plant refurbishment) and Health Care (new Planova virus-removal filter spinning plant, Bionova CDMO capacity). The capex plan for fiscal 2026 (April 2026 - March 2027) is JPY 254,000 million, including JPY 187,000 million in Material for a production capacity increase of the photosensitive insulating material PIMEL plus further Hipore coating capacity and the integrated line; the parent's asset additions for the year included costs for building a new PIMEL plant.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 (year ended March 2026) capex JPY 222,324 million (Material JPY 164,829 million, 131.3% of the prior year); plan for fiscal 2026 (April 2026 - March 2027) JPY 254,000 million (Material JPY 187,000 million; Health Care JPY 37,000 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Investment plan under Medium-Term Management Plan 2027: decision-based investment over the three years is now expected at about JPY 9,300 hundred million, slightly below the original JPY 1 trillion after review of healthcare and overseas-housing M&A; expansion-related investment is planned at JPY 6,000 hundred million, about six-tenths of it for the focus-growth businesses (pharmaceuticals, overseas housing, electronics). Portfolio transformation: businesses with sales of roughly JPY 2,030 hundred million have been restructured (including announcements through the first quarter of fiscal 2026, April-June 2026), about seven-tenths of the plan's target of restructuring businesses equal to about 20% of Material's fiscal 2024 (April 2024 - March 2025) sales.
quarterly_data.figure: about JPY 9,300 hundred million three-year investment; JPY 6,000 hundred million expansion-related; about JPY 2,030 hundred million of sales restructured

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Energy & Infrastructure (management): lithium-ion battery separator demand may fall short of expectations as automakers and battery makers revise investment plans amid slower EV growth, while energy storage systems are emerging as a new fast-growing use on surging AI-driven power demand and renewables. Management states it has set up production in North America ahead of others to meet supply-chain localization requests, building strong customer partnerships, and is expanding coating capacity in the US and Japan while facing intensifying price and technology competition from Chinese and Korean makers. It plans to start, in fiscal 2028 (the year starting April 2028), production equipment that co-produces electrolysis frames and membranes for both alkaline water electrolysis (clean hydrogen) and ion-exchange membrane chlor-alkali electrolysis.

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Portfolio moves stated in the material contracts section: the Daramic lead-acid battery separator business (under Polypore International) was transferred to buyers set up by Kingswood Capital Management, completed December 1, 2025; Asahi Kasei Advance is to be merged into Teijin Frontier, which becomes a joint venture of Teijin (80%) and Asahi Kasei (20%), effective October 1, 2026 (planned); Veloxis Pharmaceuticals completed the acquisition of all shares of Aicuris Anti-infective Cures AG on April 17, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Teijin Frontier JV: Teijin 80%, Asahi Kasei 20%

quarterly_data.quarter: Asahi Kasei annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ultra-wide-bandgap semiconductor R&D: with Nagoya University the company demonstrated an AlN/GaN/AlN high-electron-mobility transistor grown coherently on an aluminum nitride substrate, with more than twice the breakdown voltage of conventional GaN HEMTs, lower resistance and suppressed current collapse, aimed at next-generation high-frequency, high-power devices for communications and radar. In April 2025 it set up the spin-out ULTEC to develop and commercialize AlN-based deep-ultraviolet laser diodes, far-UV LEDs, deep-UV sensors and high-voltage power devices.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 2x breakdown voltage vs conventional GaN HEMTs
